posts.author: praddy06
posts.community: Afcom Holdings - Sky High Ambitions, Grounded in Reality?
posts.text: Capitalizing expenses is not necessarily “inflating the bottom line” if the expenditure genuinely creates a capital asset or provides benefits over multiple years. Similarly, non payment of advance tax does not automatically mean the company is “playing around with taxes.” Advance tax is based on the estimated tax liability, and the final liability can differ depending on timing of profits, depreciation, deductions, provisions and other legitimate tax adjustments and that alone doesn’t establish that the company acted improperly.
